title: Needs list record (needs_…)
description: What one version of the software needs (glossary: Needs list; R8, R9). Immutable, self-contained, free of profile names and port names; any two are diffable. Each need has a local name, a kind, constraints (a predicate over the kind's attributes) and wires naming abstract roles toward other needs. Which needs list a needs list was copied from is a separate made-from statement, never a field here (it would change the address). Unsigned.

name_hints.description: Testimony for readers (the software and version this list is for); never read by the mechanism.

name.description: Local handle, the target of wires. Unique within the list.

constraints.description: A predicate over the kind's attribute names; a need tests only the attributes it names. `{"kind":"lit","value":true}` is the unconstrained need.

role.description: An abstract role: `lives-in`, `reads-from`. Never a port name (decision 18).

to.description: The name of another need in this list.
